cacheVariables.//VCPKG_TARGET_TRIPLET-rationale: x64-windows-static-md: static-link our deps (no third-party DLLs at runtime) but use the DYNAMIC MSVC CRT (/MD). SkyrimNet's PublicAPI.h returns std::string by value across the DLL boundary, which requires both DLLs to share one heap — i.e. the same MSVC version and dynamic CRT linkage.
cacheVariables.//VCPKG_OVERLAY_PORTS-rationale: ports/ carries a local commonlibsse-ng-fork whose only change is a refreshed CommonLibVR tarball SHA512 — GitHub re-compressed its generated source archives, so the registry port's recorded hash no longer matches what downloads. Drop the overlay once upstream refreshes it.
